sustainability.title: Sustainability
sustainability.p1: At National Plasto, responsible manufacturing is part of how we make furniture for every space and every need. Our NATIONAL, CAPTAIN and SAPPHIRE ranges are built with reprocessed plastic, giving used plastic a long second life as durable everyday furniture.
sustainability.p2: Every one of our four plants — Howrah, Guwahati, Roorkee and Hajipur — is independently certified for environmental management, and our energy use is managed under ISO 50001.
sustainability.p3: We believe every manufacturer has a responsibility to make choices that benefit the environment and the people who work with us.

touchingLives.title: Furniture For Every Community
touchingLives.desc: From classrooms and community halls to homes in Tier 2 and Tier 3 towns, National Plasto makes durable seating affordable for everyone. We give used plastic a second life through our reprocessed ranges, keep our 1,000+ strong workforce safe under ISO 45001, and grow together with the dealers and families who depend on us.

overview.title: Rooted in 1981, Incorporated in 1997
overview.leadText: Over four decades of industrial heritage and nearly three decades of pioneering plastic injection moulding excellence.
overview.desc: Tracing foundational commercial roots back to 1981, National Plasto Products Pvt. Ltd. (NPPL) was incorporated on 29 October 1997 under the visionary leadership of Mr. Ratan Kumar Sharma. From an initial manufacturing plant in Kolkata, West Bengal, NPPL has expanded into a nationwide plastic furniture manufacturing leader with 4 advanced manufacturing hubs across India. Operating high-tonnage microprocessor injection moulding machinery from 80T up to 1,200T across over 2,00,000 sq. ft. of production floor space, we design and produce over 1,000 active moulds and products. Our 4-tier brand architecture—NEXT, NATIONAL, SAPPHIRE, and CAPTAIN—delivers ergonomic, durable, and aesthetically superior moulded furniture to millions of Indian homes, institutions, and businesses.

missionVision.vision: To be India's most trusted plastic-moulded furniture brand, setting the benchmark for ergonomic comfort, structural durability, and sustainable plastic manufacturing accessible to every home and enterprise.
missionVision.mission: Delivering high-value, long-lasting plastic-moulded furniture solutions through continuous technological innovation, rigorous 200kg load testing, and an empowered pan-India network of over 500 distribution partners.

managementIntro.title: Our Management
managementIntro.p1: Since 1997, National Plasto Products Pvt. Ltd. (NPPL) has been manufacturing plastic moulded furniture designed for every space and every need. From homes and educational institutions to healthcare facilities, government establishments and businesses across the country, our products have become part of everyday environments across India.
managementIntro.p2: What began as a single manufacturing unit has grown into four manufacturing plants located in Howrah (West Bengal), Guwahati (Assam), Roorkee (Uttarakhand) and Hajipur (Bihar). All NPPL manufacturing units are ISO certified across various levels, reflecting our commitment to consistent processes and quality standards.
managementIntro.p3: Behind this growth is a family-led management team that brings together decades of hands-on experience, strong operational knowledge and clear defined responsibilities across finance, production, sales and marketing.

leadership.name: Mr. Ratan Kumar Sharma
leadership.bio:
With 18 years of experience in the plastic furniture industry prior to establishing National Plasto Products Pvt. Ltd., Mr. Ratan Kumar Sharma brought extensive industry knowledge and practical experience to the foundation of the company in 1997.

He founded National Plasto Products Pvt. Ltd. in 1997 and has led its journey from a single manufacturing unit to four plants across Howrah, Hajipur, Guwahati and Roorkee.

Over nearly three decades, he has built the company on a foundation of perseverance, relationships and the values passed down by his father, whose guidance continues to influence his approach to business and leadership.

Under his leadership, NPPL has grown not only in scale and turnover, but also in the trust and respect it has built among its employees, partners and associates. He believes that every challenge presents an opportunity to learn, adapt and return stronger.
leadership.quote: “Every business goes through difficult phases. What matters is not avoiding losses, but learning from them and growing bigger and better each time. My father taught me that how you treat people matters as much as how you run a business — that belief has shaped this company since 1997, and it continues to guide how we build for the future.” — Mr. Ratan Kumar Sharma, Chairman & Managing Director

leadership.name: Mr. Rajkumar Sharma
leadership.bio:
Mr. Rajkumar Sharma, the eldest of the family and elder brother of Mr. Ratan Kumar Sharma, has overseen the company's financial operations since its inception in 1997.

As the senior-most member of the management team, his steady and disciplined approach to financial management and accounts has been a constant strength behind the company's growth. His experience and practical understanding continue to play an important role in shaping key financial decisions across the organisation and its four manufacturing units.
leadership.quote: Strong financial management and transparent operations are the foundation of our long-term success.

leadership.name: Late Mr. Sukhram Sharma
leadership.bio:
Mr. Sukhram Sharma, the youngest brother of Mr. Raj Kumar Sharma and Mr. Ratan Kumar Sharma, was an integral part of National Plasto Products Pvt. Ltd. and made significant contribution to the Company's growth and establishment.

He was closely involved with the factory and production operations, where his hands-on approach and dedication earned him the trust and respect of the entire factory team. He shared a strong bond with the employees and treated them like family.

Mr. Sukhram Sharma passed away three years ago, leaving behind a legacy of dedication, relationships and contribution to the Company's growth. He will always be remembered as a valued member of the NPPL family.
leadership.quote: Our machines shape the furniture, but it is our people who shape the quality, consistency, and trust behind every National Plasto product.

leadership.name: Mr. Bhavesh Sharma
leadership.bio:
Mr. Bhavesh Sharma, son of Mr. Ratan Kumar Sharma, oversees production, sales and marketing across all four manufacturing units, working closely with teams to maintain consistency in quality, output and operations.

A key part of the company's next phase of growth has been its expansion into E-Commerce. Under his leadership, NPPL has strengthened its presence on platforms such as Amazon and Flipkart, extending the company's reach beyond traditional dealer networks.

With a hands-on approach and focus on exploring new markets, he continues to drive the company's growth while remaining firmly connected to the values on which NPPL was built.
leadership.quote: With decades of dealer trust and an expanding presence across digital marketplaces, we are taking National Plasto products to more homes and businesses across the country.

leadership.name: Mr. Devesh Sharma
leadership.bio:
Mr. Devesh Sharma, the youngest member of the family and son of Late Mr. Sukhram Sharma, oversees production and sales operations across the company's manufacturing units.

Working closely with the teams on a day-to-day basis, he contributes to operational efficiency and the company's continued expansion. His attention to detail, willingness to embrace new challenges and commitment to the business reflect the evolving role of the next generation in taking NPPL forward.

As part of the next generation of leadership, he continues to carry forward the company's values while contributing to its future growth and ambitions.
leadership.quote: “Operational excellence is achieved every day through precision engineering, team empowerment, and an unwavering commitment to quality standards.”

hero.title: Policies, Warranty & Consumer Care
hero.subtitle: Our commitment to quality, consumer trust, data privacy, and ethical manufacturing practices.

qualityWarranty.title: Quality Standards & 1-Year Structural Warranty
qualityWarranty.text: National Plasto products are manufactured using 100% virgin polypropylene and precision computer-aided tooling. We warrant our moulded furniture against manufacturing structural defects, premature stress cracking, and unintended moulding flaws for a period of one (1) year from the date of retail purchase. This warranty does not cover normal wear and tear, intentional misuse, or exposure to excessive open heat sources.

privacy.title: Privacy & Data Protection Policy
privacy.text: National Plasto respects your privacy. We collect minimal personal information (such as your name, business name, telephone number, and email address) exclusively to respond to your commercial inquiries, facilitate dealership applications, and fulfill catalogue requests. We do not sell, rent, or disclose your personal information to any third parties without your explicit consent.

returnsReplacement.title: Return & Replacement Policy
returnsReplacement.text: For retail and institutional buyers, goods damaged during transit or found with manufacturing faults upon arrival must be reported within 48 hours of delivery along with photographic evidence. Our authorized dealership network or regional trade depot will promptly inspect and issue a 100% free product replacement.

shippingDispatch.title: Logistics, Shipping & Pan-India Dispatch
shippingDispatch.text: With four strategically positioned production plants in Howrah, Guwahati, Roorkee, and Hajipur, National Plasto guarantees direct-to-warehouse dispatch within 24 to 48 hours of order confirmation. Transit times generally range from 1 to 4 business days depending on dealer destination across India.
